title: James Addiction Charter Fishing
specs: Boat Sweet Release is a stable 33'9" Tiara 3100 Continental with powerful engines and top-of-the-line fishing gear
A current MN Fishing License is required; youth under 16 may fish without a license
Trout Stamp required to fish on Lake Superior except for youth under 16 and elders 65+ (who still need a MN fishing license)
No mixed groups; private charters only
Can accommodate up to 42 people with multiple boats for spring trips out of Duluth

includes: Captain will filet and Ziploc your catch
blurb: Guests fish for trout, salmon, and walleye on Lake Superior and the St. Louis River Basin. Trips are private charters only, with no mixed groups. The captain provides filleting and bagging of the catch and offers guidance and education about fishing techniques.
extraNote: Rates are for the boat, not per person · Mixed group trips are not allowed; private charters only · 3% credit card fee applies to card transactions · Knife River Marina, Superior, WI
